headline: Six Fronts Intensify as Bases Trade Hands
war_summary: Three hours after the last edition the conflict has sharpened along the same six corridors. Weathered Expanse remains the bloodiest theater, adding roughly 13,000 Colonial and 19,000 Warden dead in the past 24 hours and recording 35 ownership changes, the latest only minutes ago. Callahans Passage follows with about 14,600 Colonial and 15,600 Warden losses and 14 base swaps, the most recent seconds ago. Stlican Shelf logs 3,700 Colonial and 4,500 Warden casualties across 25 exchanges, while Nevish Line tallies 7,600 Colonial and 7,900 Warden dead with 19 changes. Palantine Berm contributes 1,100 Colonial and 1,000 Warden casualties over 29 flips, and Kuura Strand adds 1,100 Colonial and 1,100 Warden losses amid 14 events. Hourly casualty rates are accelerating on Callahans, Palantine and Kuura, cooling on Weathered, Stlican and Nevish, while enlistments surge on Palantine and Kuura. The remaining sectors stay largely static, held wholly by one faction with only low‑level attrition and no ownership activity.
